## Execution tips

- Grasp flat upper-middle stamp sidewalls that allow full pad contact, avoiding the rounded top and raised carvings. Leave the lower stamping face exposed to reduce slipping and finger contact with the table.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the grasp section. Before closing, use a side view to confirm that the fingers enclose the body rather than merely overlapping in the image without grasping it.
- Near the yellow area, keep the stamping face downward and approach the tabletop steadily to avoid pressing on an edge at an angle or dragging sideways and shifting it.
- Before release, confirm the stamp's lower end is supported by the table. When opening, avoid moving it with the fingertips, which could cause a fall or tip and shift it from the target.
